# Genome list

```{r}
species <- list.dirs("./data/public_genomes",recursive = T) %>% str_split("\\/",simplify = T) %>% .[,4] %>% subset(.!='') %>% subset(!. %in% c("sliquefaciens","cportucalensis"))

datasets <- pbmcapply::pbmclapply(species,FUN=function(x){
  read_delim(paste0("./data/public_genomes/",x,"/NCBI_Pathogens_",x,"_072026.tsv"))
  
},mc.cores=5)
names(datasets) <- species
```

# Create genome label
```{r}
get_chromosome_or_complete <- function(dataset){
  dataset[,'chromosome_or_complete'] <- dataset[['Level']] %in% c("Complete Genome","Chromosome")
   return(dataset) 
}

datasets <- lapply(datasets,get_chromosome_or_complete)
 
lapply(datasets,FUN=function(x){
  
paste0("Number of genomes: ",sum(x$chromosome_or_complete ))
})
```

# Handle duplicates
```{r}
handle_duplicates <- function(dataset){
  biosamples <- unique(sort(dataset$BioSample))
  duplicates <- dataset$BioSample[duplicated(dataset$BioSample)]
  # Best genome choice
  best_genome_choice <- dataset %>%
  filter(BioSample %in% biosamples) %>%
  group_by(BioSample) %>%
  arrange(desc(N50), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(sample = BioSample, best_assembly = Assembly)
 
  dataset$BioSample_best_genome <- dataset$Assembly %in% best_genome_choice$best_assembly
 return(dataset) 
}

datasets <- pbmcapply::pbmclapply(datasets,handle_duplicates,mc.cores=5)
 
lapply(datasets,FUN=function(x){
  
paste0("Number of genomes: ",sum(x$BioSample_best_genome ))
})

lapply(datasets,FUN=function(x){
  
paste0("Number of non-best genomes: ",sum(!x$BioSample_best_genome ))
})
```

# Date data
```{r}
get_date_fast <- function(x){ 
  x <- as.character(x)

  bad <- (x == "") | grepl("/", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x[bad] <- NA

  parsed <- lubridate::parse_date_time(
    x,
    orders = c("y", "ym", "ymd", "ymd_HMS"),
    truncated = 3,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  lubridate::as_date(parsed)
} 

get_date_data <- function(dataset){
  dataset$collection_date <- get_date_fast(dataset$`Collection date`)
  dataset$collection_year <-  lubridate::year(dataset$collection_date) 
  dataset$has_date <- !is.na(dataset$collection_date)
  return(dataset)
}
 
datasets <- pbmcapply::pbmclapply(datasets,get_date_data,mc.cores=5) 
```

# Location
```{r}
recode_country <- function(x){
   split <- str_split(x,":",simplify = T)
   country <- trimws(split[,1],which='both')
   country <- ifelse(country %in% c("not available",'not collected','not determined','not provided',"missing", "-","","restricted access","Restricted access"),NA,country)
   country <- recode(country,
                     "Berlgium" = "Belgium",
                     "Cambodge" = "Cambodia",
                     "KSA" = "Kingdom of Saudi Arabia",
                     "UAE" = "United Arab Emirates",
                     "United Kingdom (England, Wales & N. Ireland)" = "United Kingdom",
                     "USA" = "United States")
   return(country)
}

recode_location_data <- function(dataset){
  dataset$country <-  recode_country(dataset$Location)
  dataset$continent <- countrycode(dataset$country, origin = 'country.name', destination = 'continent')
  dataset$has_location <- is.na(dataset$country) ==F 
  return(dataset)
}

datasets <- pbmcapply::pbmclapply(datasets,recode_location_data,mc.cores=5) 
```

# Save full metadata

```{r}
lapply(names(datasets),FUN=function(x){ 
  dataset <- datasets[[x]] 
  info <- paste0("Number of isolates in the ",x, " collection: ",nrow(dataset),"\n")
  cat(info)
  path <- paste0("./data/public_genomes/",x,"/NCBI_Pathogens_",x,"_metadata_curated_072026.RDS")
  saveRDS(dataset,path)
})
```

# Save genomes with location and time data and use their best BioSample genome
```{r} 
lapply(names(datasets),FUN=function(x){ 
  dataset <- datasets[[x]]
  dataset_w_spatiotemporal_data <- subset(dataset,is.na(country)==F & is.na(collection_date)==F & chromosome_or_complete==T & BioSample_best_genome ==T) 
  cat(paste0("Number of isolates with complete or chromosomal assemblies with spatiotemporal data in the ",x, " collection: ",nrow(dataset_w_spatiotemporal_data),'\n'))
  path <- paste0("./data/public_genomes/",x,"/NCBI_Pathogens_",x,"_isolates_w_spatiotemporal_data_072026.txt")
  writeLines(dataset_w_spatiotemporal_data$Assembly,path) 
})
```
